_comment: The rack at PSI (Oct 2026): boards in FSUDAQ's boardOrder, Cherenkov on Digi-1443 ch6 and Digi-15880 ch15, RF on Digi-62839 ch15. Tracker channels in patch-panel (BNC) order, which for the 8-channel boards is 1399, 30505, 30508, 1443 (T2 17-46), not their link order; since 3 Nov 2026 15880 ch8-15 are swapped with the last channel of each other board (BNC008-015 with BNC031/047/062/079/087/103/095/111). cabling.csv is written by write_cabling.py's rules. Read by online_dashboard.py at every new run; see experiment.example.json.
_control_hosts: machines besides odin whose browser may use Clear and the settings (host names: looked up again every 30 s, as DHCP renumbers the network). WS15-TDOYLE = the counting room PC.
